key_insight: Fit-LRP tightens neural network verification by optimizing affine bounds directly over unions of polytopes rather than enclosing them in axis-aligned boxes.
engineering_relevance: It better matches oblique and non-convex regions arising in cyber-physical reachability, obstacle avoidance, and neural Lyapunov certification.
method: Represent non-convex verification domains as unions of polytopes.
Optimize affine bounds over these domains using small, low-dimensional linear programs.
Integrate into LiRPA and α,β-CROWN branch-and-bound to enable earlier pruning.
evidence_signal: On ARCH-COMP and neural Lyapunov benchmarks, the abstract reports 47× less branching on the hardest region, a 15× reduction in worst-case verification time, and—with region-wise partitioning—6.1× faster verification on one CPU than α,β-CROWN on a GPU.
watch_item: Exactness applies to optimizing the affine relaxation, not the nonlinear network itself; scalability to higher-dimensional domains or many polytopes warrants evaluation.
paper_title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
